_note: Hand-authored inputs for the endoscope scene. ECM joint limits and the PSM2 re-posture are exploratory simulation choices, not verified hardware travel or a clinical setup.

ecm.insertion_home_basis: The CAD carrier bar ends 59 mm behind the scope tip at insertion 0; at 50 mm it still touched the skin at the motion corners, 80 mm keeps it further out.

search.min_joint_margin_basis: Normalised distance of the RCM joints (not the lift) from their limits; the 10 deg corner test showed shoulder/carrier saturating below about 0.05.

motion.basis: The 10 deg / 15 mm range made the ECM carrier touch the skin and the ECM setup links touch PSM2 at the corners; the endoscope only needs view adjustment in this task.

co_dock.motion_check_basis: PSM2 pick-and-place range, checked for ECM contacts only (PSM2-anatomy contacts are left to the runtime guard). Without it the re-postured PSM2 mount touched the ECM mount as soon as PSM2 swung.
co_dock.basis: In the base scene the PSM2 mount/shoulder already intersect the parked ECM; PSM2 is re-postured in its null space with its instrument pose unchanged.

psm._note: Demo amplitudes equal the base-scene controller. Manual limits default to the same values; overrides widen them per arm (exploratory, collision-guarded at runtime).
psm.limit_overrides_basis: At the docked insertion (40 mm) the PSM2 tip is visible only through a narrow gap between the pubic bones; retracting toward the CAD lower bound (0 mm) brings it into the open, visible cavity above them.
psm.grip_basis: Setting both jaw joints to +0.5 rad opens the jaw tips about 10 mm; 0 is closed.
